title: Attractive, Sturdy, Very Useful
text: Attractive, Sturdy, Very Useful. Great idea to have separate cutting boards for 4 types of food to help avoid cross-contamination.  The boards seem durable and of good quality.  Also the storage case is attractive and seems sturdy.  What's not to like?  Just one thing that occurs to me.  After using an individual cutting board, before inserting it back into the storage rack, you need to make sure it is really clean or food particles could fall down into the rack.  Of course normally you would clean a cutting board after use anyway.  If you don't want to worry about a complete cleaning of a cutting board after using it, you could use all four boards for anything you want to chop and then after use, put each in the dishwasher after use.  When all 4 are dirty, you run your dishwasher load and then restore 4 clean cutting boards to the rack.  Definitely some good advantages to having 4 cutting boards in a slim attractive rack instead of just one all-purpose cutting board.

features: Set of 4 plastic color-coded cutting boards with a brushed stainless-steel storage case. Designed to prevent cross-contamination of different food types.
Index-style tabs on boards indicate which food type they should be used for - raw meat, raw fish, vegetables or cooked food
Easy-clean, knife-friendly cutting surfaces with crumb-catching edges, non-slip feet. Easy-access storage case with non-slip feet.
Board size: 13.4 x 9.4 inches, Case size: 14.8 x 11.2 x 3.3
Cutting boards - dishwasher safe. Storage case - wipe clean with a damp cloth.
description: Since its launch in 2008, Index has been a worldwide bestseller, helping reduce cross-contamination of food with a simple-yet-effective, color-coded system of boards. This set features a stainless steel case and black cutting boards. As before, the knife-friendly boards feature easy-grip tabs with food-type icons, non-slip feet on both sides and sloping edges to catch crumbs and liquids. The storage case also has a non-slip base. Chopping boards – dishwasher safe. Storage case – wipe clean with a damp cloth.
